'Anmelden' (→ /app, which sends signed-out people to /login) and 'Kostenlos starten' (→ /login) end on the same login page; there is no separate sign-up entry.
Hand-written menus (ProductMenu, MobileMenu) with their own open/close logic instead of shared primitives; the mega menu opens on hover.
